entities.summary: Taina Bofferding (b. 1982-11-22, Esch-sur-Alzette) was a civil rights leader or advocate of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Esch-sur-Alzette and Luxembourg. Known in the fields of luxembourg, labor organizers, europe.
